Public artifact provenance and impact analysis.
The graph is intentionally derived from public workspace files instead of
trusting model-authored metadata.  It never descends into protected directories
and never executes user code.  The result powers beginner-friendly actions such
as "modify this chart" while keeping the actual edit bounded to explicit source
Collect string file literals below one call without evaluating code.
Return literals used by actual write/export calls.
The old scanner treated *every* path literal as an output.  A plotting
script that read ``problem_1_results.json`` and wrote ``fig_q1.pdf`` thus
granted write access to both.  AST inspection keeps the provenance closure
narrow: read/open(..., "r") inputs are never promoted to writable outputs.
